name: The captain's engine
engine: Spend stamina on extra passes; covering partners and the captain keep the stamina coming.
about: Stamina is the currency. Twice an attack a short pass can be paid for with legs instead of a decision, so every breather the team earns buys another pass before the shot. Fabián covers half of Yamal's running, Cubarsí half of Olmo's; Rodri breathes again after a clean recovery; tired men find a second wind. Captain Rodri gives the same breather again once a moment, up to three times a match.
